title: [review] slot_claim.py:417: validate_interleaved_patt
description: The function iterates slots assuming they are sorted ascending, but does not verify this precondition. If called with unsorted slots that would otherwise match the pattern (e.g., [3, 0] for ordinal=0, gateway_count=3), it returns False incorrectly. Should either sort internally or document/enforce the precondition.
